overview: You named the fourth mouth hope, and you did not feed it. The margin says not every king a crown, and some are only a cough. The captain's scene can move. You added less than you wanted. The wall stayed as Sunday left it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the margin, saw how little was new, and stopped.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Wrote that some kings are only a cough

summary: Wrote that some kings are only a cough
